function.description: Sets up a new reminder for a specific medication. This tool allows users to schedule when and how often they need to take their medicine, and specifies the dosage.

dosage_amount.description: The amount of medication to take (e.g., 250 mg, 1 tablet).

dosage_unit.description: The unit for the dosage amount (e.g., 'mg', 'tablet', 'ml').

frequency_type.description: How often the medication should be taken (e.g., 'daily', 'weekly', 'hourly').

start_date.description: The date when the reminder should start (YYYY-MM-DD).

time_of_day.description: The specific time of day for the reminder (HH:MM).

function.name: get_medication_reminders
function.description: Retrieves a list of all active or pending medication reminders for a user. It can filter reminders by medication name or status.

medication_name_filter.description: Optional filter to retrieve reminders for a specific medication name.

status_filter.description: Optional filter to retrieve reminders by their status (e.g., 'active', 'paused', 'completed').

user_id.description: The ID of the user whose reminders are being retrieved.

function.name: update_medication_reminder
function.description: Modifies an existing medication reminder. Users can update parameters such as dosage, frequency, start date, or time of day for a specific reminder.

reminder_id.description: The unique identifier of the reminder to update.

new_dosage_amount.description: Optional: The new amount of medication to take.

new_dosage_unit.description: Optional: The new unit for the dosage amount.

new_time_of_day.description: Optional: The new specific time of day for the reminder (HH:MM).

is_active.description: Optional: Set to true to activate or false to pause the reminder.

function.name: delete_medication_reminder
function.description: Removes an existing medication reminder. This action permanently deletes the reminder from the system.

reminder_id.description: The unique identifier of the reminder to delete.

user_id.description: The ID of the user who owns the reminder.

function.description: Finds the very next upcoming medication reminder for a specific user. This is useful for quickly informing users about their immediate medication schedule.

function.name: mark_reminder_as_taken

reminder_id.description: The unique identifier of the reminder to mark as taken.

taken_time.description: The actual time the medication was taken (HH:MM).

user_id.description: The ID of the user marking the reminder.

amount.description: The amount of money to be paid.

function.name: get_payment_details

payment_id.description: The unique identifier of the payment to be refunded.
